summary.name: KushoAI
summary.one_liner: KushoAI is an AI-driven testing and reliability platform that generates API tests from OpenAPI specs or Postman collections, runs security scans, and self-heals tests inside CI/CD pipelines.
keywords: alternative to general purpose llm testing
use_cases: Generate API test suites from OpenAPI or Postman definitions
Catch breaking API changes before release
Continuous API vulnerability scanning in CI
Keep test suites updated as APIs change
Test end-to-end user workflows across services and UI
summary.what_it_does: KushoAI reads OpenAPI specs or Postman collections and generates a test suite automatically. It checks API changes against the contract to flag breaking changes, and detects contract drift so impacted tests are updated. It runs security scans for vulnerabilities, misconfigurations, and access control risks, and runs them in the CI pipeline. It also covers multi-step workflows across services, databases, and UI, and assigns each release an AI-computed risk score. The page states that it acts as a gatekeeper in CI to enforce test quality and coverage.
notable: Self-healing tests that adapt to API contract changes
AI risk score per release for ship or no-go decisions
Unified API, workflow, and UI testing from one platform
Claims SOC 2 and ISO compliance with on-prem deployment, RBAC and SSO
caveats: Pricing is not described on the page; it refers to a pricing question but gives no details
Performance figures (80% less QA time, 93%+ coverage, under 30 day payback) are vendor claims shown on the page
Enterprise-oriented; access requires talking to sales
